comparisons.peer_summary: Net revenues increased 16% to $53.51 billion in 2024, driven primarily by higher revenues in Global Banking & Markets (Equities, Investment banking, FICC) and Asset & Wealth Management (Equity investments, Management fees), with slight increases in Platform Solutions.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs reported revenue growth in their Markets segments for 2024, with Equity Markets being a primary driver. Citi's Markets revenue increased 6%, specifically driven by a 26% increase in Equity Markets. Similarly, Goldman Sachs reported that the increase in net revenues in Global Banking & Markets primarily reflected higher net revenues in Equities. While Citi details specific percentage growth for Equity Markets, GS highlights it as a key component of the segment's overall performance alongside Fixed Income.

sentences.text: Markets revenues of $19.8 billion increased 6%, driven by a 26% increase in Equity Markets and a 1% increase in Fixed Income Markets.

The increase in net revenues in Global Banking & Markets primarily reflected higher net revenues in Equities, significantly higher Investment banking fees and higher net revenues in Fixed Income, Currency and Commodities (FICC).

comparisons.peer_summary: Principal transactions revenue increased, driven by higher Equity Markets revenue in Prime Finance and Equity Derivatives, partially offset by lower Fixed Income Markets revenue due to declines in macro businesses, which were partially offset by higher revenue in Securitized Products.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and JPMorgan analyzed their Markets revenue performance by distinguishing between Equity and Fixed Income segments. Citi reported a 1% increase in Fixed Income Markets alongside a 26% surge in Equity Markets. JPMorgan reported that its principal transactions revenue (part of Markets/CIB) saw higher Equity Markets revenue, which was partially offset by lower Fixed Income Markets revenue. This highlights a divergent performance in Fixed Income between the two peers, where Citi saw modest growth while JPMorgan saw declines.
